name: What can go wrong with drywall in a room addition?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with drywall in a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uneven framing, moisture issues, or missed rough-ins can cause cracked seams, nail pops, bulges, and finish defects later. If the addition is in a busy metro area like Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, scheduling delays can also happen if the project is not ready for the drywall phase on time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems include cracks, seams showing through paint, and delays if framing or rough-ins are not finished correctly before drywall starts.
